items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And by Roy, and Sean. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, they was all Roy and Happy and all of them, they was all good drummers.

ctx.x: He was with P. Rohn. P. Rohn. That's one of the best drumming head, you know, in fact, I mean, he's one of the best. And I see Paul Barbera, I mean, he was good at that time too.

Oh yeah, they was all Roy and Happy and all of them, they was all good drummers. But like I said, old man, he was the king of all of them, old man Contra, you see. Cause he know that music, I mean, understand what I mean, he teached all of them. I mean, he's one of the best, I mean.
